title: Claude Notes feedback log
description: The one-way channel from the panel back to the agent, at .claude/notes_feedback.json. The agent only sees it when next invoked, so every entry must be self-contained and durable. NOTE FOR IMPLEMENTERS: a parse failure of this file MUST NOT cause it to be overwritten (FR-035) - the current code returns an empty object on a catch and the next append writes it back, destroying every captured answer.

consumed.description: NEW (FR-014). Set once the entry has been handed to the agent, so the same answer is never applied twice and pruning knows what is safe to drop first.

boardTitle.description: NEW. The title of the board that was live when the mark was made - without it, a mark cannot be related back to a board once the live board has moved on.

questionId.description: Refers to a question's id on the board. This is the only cross-document reference in the whole model.

question.description: The question text, copied at answer time so the entry stays self-contained after the board is replaced.

points.description: Board-pixel coordinates. MUST be decimated before storage (FR-040) - the current code pushes one point per pointermove, so a single long stroke can be thousands of points.

$comment: COORDINATE SEMANTICS: x/y in 'sticky' and the points in 'drawing' are board-pixel coordinates from the layout that was live when the mark was made. A re-layout shifts everything, so they mean 'roughly here', never exact geometry. An agent reading this file should treat a drawing as 'the user circled something around here' and ask if it cannot tell what a stroke points at. BOUNDS: the log is capped by claudeNotes.feedback.maxEntries; consumed entries are pruned first, oldest first (SC-008).
